alexsmobs:void_worm.name: Void Worm
alexsmobs:void_worm.where: Craft or find a Mysterious Worm and throw it into the void below the End islands: the Void Worm rises to take it.

born_in_chaos_v1:lord_pumpkinhead.name: Lord Pumpkinhead
born_in_chaos_v1:lord_pumpkinhead.where: The headless lord answers Lord Pumpkinhead's Lamp; JEI shows how to fill and use it. He rides out at night.

born_in_chaos_v1:mother_spider.name: Spiders Mother
born_in_chaos_v1:mother_spider.where: Spawns at night in the Overworld with Born in Chaos's horrors, more often on a Blood Moon. Her brood comes with her.

born_in_chaos_v1:nightmare_stalker.name: Nightmare Stalker
born_in_chaos_v1:nightmare_stalker.where: Hunts at night in the Overworld, rarely: it finds you. Blood Moons bring it more often.

born_in_chaos_v1:supreme_bonescaller.name: Supreme Bonescaller
born_in_chaos_v1:supreme_bonescaller.where: A rare night spawn in the Overworld, raising skeletons around it. Look for the ring of risen dead.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:gauntlet.name: Nether Gauntlet
bosses_of_mass_destruction:gauntlet.where: Sleeps in its arena in the Nether: a giant stone fist.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich.name: Night Lich
bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich.where: Waits at the top of a tower in snowy lands.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith.name: Obsidilith
bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith.where: A pillar of living obsidian on the End islands.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:void_blossom.name: Void Blossom
bosses_of_mass_destruction:void_blossom.where: Grows in a hollow deep under the Overworld, in lush caves.

cataclysm:ancient_remnant.name: Ancient Remnant
cataclysm:ancient_remnant.where: Buried under the desert in the Cursed Pyramid.

cataclysm:aptrgangr.name: Aptrgangr
cataclysm:aptrgangr.where: The draugr chieftain inside the Frosted Prison, in icy lands.

cataclysm:clawdian.name: Clawdian
cataclysm:clawdian.where: Lives in Cataclysm's ruins at sea. Search warm oceans and coasts.

cataclysm:ender_guardian.name: Ender Guardian
cataclysm:ender_guardian.where: Guards the Ruined Citadel on the outer End islands.

cataclysm:ignis.name: Ignis
cataclysm:ignis.where: Fights in the Burning Arena in the Nether.

cataclysm:kobolediator.name: Kobolediator
cataclysm:kobolediator.where: The kobolds' champion in Cataclysm's desert sites.

cataclysm:maledictus.name: Maledictus
cataclysm:maledictus.where: Chained at the bottom of the Frosted Prison, in icy lands.

cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.name: Netherite Monstrosity
cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.where: Sleeps in the Soul Black Smith forge in the Nether.

cataclysm:scylla.name: Scylla
cataclysm:scylla.where: Rules the Acropolis, an island temple in a stormy sea.

cataclysm:the_harbinger.name: The Harbinger
cataclysm:the_harbinger.where: Waits to be switched on deep in the Ancient Factory.

cataclysm:the_leviathan.name: The Leviathan
cataclysm:the_leviathan.where: Rules the Sunken City at the bottom of the ocean.

cataclysm:the_prowler.name: The Prowler
cataclysm:the_prowler.where: Patrols the halls of the Ancient Factory.

cataclysm:wadjet.name: Wadjet
cataclysm:wadjet.where: Guards Cataclysm's desert ruins, near the Cursed Pyramid.

companions:sacred_pontiff.name: Sacred Pontiff
companions:sacred_pontiff.where: Holds court in a jungle Monkey Temple.

darkdoppelganger:dark_doppelganger.name: Dark Doppelganger
darkdoppelganger:dark_doppelganger.where: Build a Shadow Altar and use a Shadow Orb on it (JEI shows both): your darker self steps out.

discerning_the_eldritch:ascended_one.name: The Ascended One
discerning_the_eldritch:ascended_one.where: The cultists' god, called up at the heart of a cultist base. Follow the blood cultists.

discerning_the_eldritch:blood_matriarch.name: Blood Matriarch
discerning_the_eldritch:blood_matriarch.where: Leads the blood cultists from their hut.

discerning_the_eldritch:electromancer.name: Electromancer
discerning_the_eldritch:electromancer.where: Commands storms from the top of its tower.

graveyard:lich.name: Corrupted Champion
graveyard:lich.where: Call it up at the altar of a Lich Prison (The Graveyard).

iceandfire:cyclops.name: Cyclops
iceandfire:cyclops.where: Keeps its flock in a cave by the sea.

iceandfire:deathworm.name: Death Worm
iceandfire:deathworm.where: Burrows under desert sand. Walk the dunes and it will find you.

iceandfire:dread_lich.name: Dread Lich
iceandfire:dread_lich.where: Rules a mausoleum in the frozen north.

iceandfire:fire_dragon.name: Fire Dragon
iceandfire:fire_dragon.where: Nests in roosts in warm lands and in fire dragon caves.

iceandfire:gorgon.name: Gorgon
iceandfire:gorgon.where: Waits in her temple. Don't look at her.

iceandfire:hydra.name: Hydra
iceandfire:hydra.where: Lairs in a cave in the swamps.

iceandfire:ice_dragon.name: Ice Dragon
iceandfire:ice_dragon.where: Nests in roosts in frozen lands and in ice dragon caves.

iceandfire:lightning_dragon.name: Lightning Dragon
iceandfire:lightning_dragon.where: Nests in roosts in dry lands and in lightning dragon caves.

iceandfire:sea_serpent.name: Sea Serpent
iceandfire:sea_serpent.where: Swims the deep oceans and surfaces in storms.

irons_spellbooks:citadel_keeper.name: Ancient Knight
irons_spellbooks:citadel_keeper.where: Ancient Knights still guard Iron's Citadel.

irons_spellbooks:cryomancer.name: Cryomancer
irons_spellbooks:cryomancer.where: Ice mages wander the frozen lands and guard Iron's cold ruins.

irons_spellbooks:dead_king.name: The Dead King
irons_spellbooks:dead_king.where: Rises from his throne in the Catacombs. A Wayward Compass points the way; a Dead King Phylactery raises him again.

irons_spellbooks:fire_boss.name: Echo of Tyros, First Flamebearer
irons_spellbooks:fire_boss.where: Burns at the heart of Iron's Citadel.

irons_spellbooks:ice_spider.name: Ice Spider
irons_spellbooks:ice_spider.where: Weaves its den in icy caves.

irons_spellbooks:pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
irons_spellbooks:pyromancer.where: Lives at the top of a pyromancer tower.

kingsandmonsters:ogre_grunt_captain.name: Grunt Captain
kingsandmonsters:ogre_grunt_captain.where: Leads every ogre outpost in the plains and swamps.

kingsandmonsters:ogre_lord.name: Ogre King
kingsandmonsters:ogre_lord.where: Sits on his throne in the Ogre King's Fort.

legendary_monsters:cloud_golem.name: Cumulonimbus
legendary_monsters:cloud_golem.where: Guards the Cloudy Temple, high in the sky.

legendary_monsters:dune_sentinel.name: Dune Sentinel
legendary_monsters:dune_sentinel.where: Wakes in a Ruined Pyramid in the desert.

legendary_monsters:endersent.name: Chorusent
legendary_monsters:endersent.where: Stands in the remains of an ancient tower.

legendary_monsters:fractured_apostle.name: Fractured Apostle
legendary_monsters:fractured_apostle.where: Leads the dead in the Collapsed Kingdom's arena.

legendary_monsters:frostbitten_golem.name: Frostbitten Golem
legendary_monsters:frostbitten_golem.where: Guards the Frostbitten Temple in the snow.

legendary_monsters:lava_eater.name: Lava Eater
legendary_monsters:lava_eater.where: Nests in the Nether's lava seas.

legendary_monsters:posessed_paladin.name: Possessed Paladin
legendary_monsters:posessed_paladin.where: Fights in the Collapsed Kingdom's great arena.

legendary_monsters:shulker_mimic.name: Shulker Mimic
legendary_monsters:shulker_mimic.where: Hides among the chests of a Shulker Tower in the End.

legendary_monsters:the_obliterator.name: The Obliterator
legendary_monsters:the_obliterator.where: Waits on a Space Station in the End.

legendary_monsters:warped_fungussus.name: Warped Fungussus
legendary_monsters:warped_fungussus.where: Grows in its nest in a warped forest.

legendary_monsters:withered_abomination.name: Withered Abomination
legendary_monsters:withered_abomination.where: Waits in the remains of a soul fortress.

minecraft:elder_guardian.name: Elder Guardian
minecraft:elder_guardian.where: Three of them guard every ocean monument.

minecraft:ender_dragon.name: Ender Dragon
minecraft:ender_dragon.where: Circles the main End island. Reach the End through a stronghold's portal.

minecraft:warden.name: Warden
minecraft:warden.where: Rises in the deep dark of an ancient city when the shriekers call it. Sneak.

minecraft:wither.name: Wither
minecraft:wither.where: Build it yourself: four soul sand in a T and three wither skeleton skulls on top. Do it far from home.

mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.name: Ferrous Wroughtnaut
mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.where: Stands in its chamber, deep underground.

mowziesmobs:frostmaw.name: Frostmaw
mowziesmobs:frostmaw.where: Sleeps in the snow on frozen plains.

mowziesmobs:naga.name: Naga
mowziesmobs:naga.where: Flies along sea cliffs and ocean coasts.

mowziesmobs:umvuthi.name: Umvuthi, the Sunbird
mowziesmobs:umvuthi.where: Rules the Umvuthana grove in the savanna.

mutantmonsters:mutant_creeper.name: Mutant Creeper
mutantmonsters:mutant_creeper.where: A rare night spawn in the Overworld.

mutantmonsters:mutant_enderman.name: Mutant Enderman
mutantmonsters:mutant_enderman.where: A rare night spawn in the Overworld.

mutantmonsters:mutant_skeleton.name: Mutant Skeleton
mutantmonsters:mutant_skeleton.where: A rare night spawn in the Overworld.

mutantmonsters:mutant_zombie.name: Mutant Zombie
mutantmonsters:mutant_zombie.where: A rare night spawn in the Overworld.

twilightforest:alpha_yeti.name: Alpha Yeti
twilightforest:alpha_yeti.where: Lairs in a yeti cave in the Twilight Forest's snowy lands.

twilightforest:hydra.name: Hydra
twilightforest:hydra.where: Lairs in the Twilight Forest's fire swamp.

twilightforest:lich.name: Twilight Lich
twilightforest:lich.where: Waits at the top of the Lich Tower in the Twilight Forest.

twilightforest:minoshroom.name: Minoshroom
twilightforest:minoshroom.where: Guards the heart of the Labyrinth in the Twilight Forest's swamps.

twilightforest:naga.name: Naga
twilightforest:naga.where: Coils in the Naga Courtyard in the Twilight Forest.

twilightforest:snow_queen.name: Snow Queen
twilightforest:snow_queen.where: Rules the Aurora Palace in the Twilight Forest's glacier.

twilightforest:ur_ghast.name: Ur-Ghast
twilightforest:ur_ghast.where: Waits at the top of a Dark Tower in the Twilight Forest.
